title: Physics Play Zone
description: A hands-on environment where students explore motion, gravity, energy, and mechanics through interactive experiments and real-world simulations.

title: Agro Innovation Lab
description: Blending ancestral farming practices with modern scientific techniques to promote sustainable, high-yield agriculture.

title: Mechanical Discovery Yard
description: An open-air learning space showcasing levers, pulleys, gears, and machines that demonstrate the fundamentals of mechanical engineering.

title: Renewable Energy Pavilion
description: Interactive models of solar, wind, and hydro systems designed to teach clean energy concepts through practical demonstrations.

title: Soil & Sustainability Lab
description: A research-focused zone where visitors learn about soil health, composting, and eco-friendly farming techniques.

title: Astronomy Observation Deck
description: A guided stargazing and telescope experience introducing celestial bodies, space science, and night-sky navigation.

title: Innovation Workshop Studio
description: A maker-style studio encouraging students to build prototypes, conduct experiments, and transform curiosity into tangible creations.
